description:
Who We Are 

 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 

 What We Offer 

 Location:
Hsinchu,TWN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 through in-depth understanding of customer technologies and critical gaps and work throughout the work cycle until the implementation of the solution
 Technically leads difficult, complex application activities and team
 Leads the execution teams ß-sites, evaluation and demos at customers site, through high involvement in the SOW and commitment schedule 
 Interfaces with the customer regarding technical requirements analysis and schedule 
 Define/approve Product application support plans for installation
 Create & Lead new methodologies in order to optimized system performance for specific application
 Analysis, Develop and  Transfer new application capabilities in the system envelope from product division to customer application support team
 Lead customer Technical review meetings
 
 Functional Knowledge 
 Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines
 
 Business Expertise 
 Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market
 
 Leadership 
 Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements
 
 Problem Solving 
 Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information
 
 Impact 
 Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies
 
 Interpersonal Skills 
 Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus
 
 Role Summary 
 The System Analyst (SA) is responsible for requirement clarification, process modeling, documentation, and defining integration specifications. In the early stages, the SA plays a leading role by confirming the project scope and system blueprint, translating customer manufacturing requirements into scalable MES solutions for ATP.
 As the project progresses to the mid-stage, the SA shifts focus to integration coordination, ensuring alignment across systems and stakeholders. In the later stages, the SA transitions into an advisory role, guiding implementation teams to ensure successful and high-quality delivery.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Solution Design & Architecture 
 Lead solution design for MES for ATP implementations projects.
 Translate customer manufacturing processes into MES functional and technical architecture.
 Define system landscape, including application, integration, and infrastructure components.
 Identify and groom solution gaps and propose customization or enhancement strategies.
 Provide technical leadership during project engagement and execution.
 
 2. Customer Engagement & Consulting 
 Work closely with customers to gather and validate requirements.
 Provide expert consultation on MES capabilities, best practices, and system design.
 Support pre-sales activities including solution proposals and technical presentations.
 
 3. Cross-functional Coordination 
 Collaborate with: Application engineering
 Infrastructure / OS / DBA teams
 Integration / automation teams
 
 Ensure alignment across all workstreams for end-to-end solution delivery .
 
 4 . Governance, Risk & Quality 
 Identify technical risks before and during project delivery.
 Review solution design, code, and deployment approach.
 Ensure compliance with standards, quality processes, and audit requirements .
 
 5 . Documentation & Standards 
 The capability to produce high-level and detail design documents, like: Solution architecture
 Interface design and strategy
 System Requirement Specification
 Functional Design Specification
 
 Define best practices and reusable frameworks for future projects.
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Computer, Electronics & Industry bachelor’s degree or MBA with Information System background or related fields
 5+ years experience in MES / CIM / manufacturing systems in a production semiconductor FE/BE.  LCD, LED or electronics environments is a plus.
 Strong knowledge of 300works or similar MES platforms and ATP domain knowledge
 Experience with system architecture, integration, and large-scale deployment 
 Solid understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes ( FE and BE operations) 
 Flexibility to travel worldwide, especially China , to conduct deployment projects
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
 Experience in customer-facing consulting roles 
 Good communication skills (English and Chinese required)
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Knowledge of MES, like: 300works, FactoryWorks, SiView, Camstart, PROMIS, FAB300…
 Familiarity with infrastructure architecture (Linux, network, database)
 Familiarity with message bus, ERP, MCS, EA or subsystems in a full auto FAB
 Solid skills and experience in Unix , Linux and Windows operating systems, networking, shell scripting, Jenkins and docker are plus
 Software development or coding experience is preferred.
 
 Key Competencies 
 Solution thinking & system-level perspective
 Strong leadership and decision-making capability
 Excellent communication with both technical & business stakeholders
 Risk management and structured problem solving
 
 
 Additional Information 
 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 50% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes 
 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
